name: dynatrader-workspace
description: Open-source trading and DeFi AI agent runtime with integrated terminal UI

scripts.build: bun run --filter @dyna/core build && bun run --filter @dynatrader/ink build && bun run --filter @dyna/plugin-dynamind-api build && bun run --filter dynatrader build && bun run --filter @dynatrader/ui build
scripts.build:ui: bun run --filter @dyna/core build && bun run --filter @dynatrader/ink build && bun run --filter @dyna/plugin-dynamind-api build && bun run --filter @dynatrader/ui build
scripts.release:check: bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun run --filter dynatrader typecheck && bun run --filter @dynatrader/ui typecheck && bun run --filter @dyna/plugin-dynamind-api typecheck && bun run lint && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --reporter=dot && bun run --filter @dynatrader/ui test && bun run --filter @dynatrader/ink test && bun run release:package-smoke
scripts.typecheck:ui: bun run --filter @dyna/core build && bun run --filter @dynatrader/ink typecheck && bun run --filter @dyna/plugin-dynamind-api build && bun run --filter @dynatrader/ui typecheck
scripts.lint: biome lint packages/core/src packages/cli/src packages/ui/src packages/ink/src packages/dynamind-api-plugin/src
scripts.typecheck:plugin: bun run --filter @dyna/core build && bun run --filter @dyna/plugin-dynamind-api typecheck

author: DynaTrader Contributors
